description: This is a PHP source file defining the ProjectController class, which extends SugarController. It contains actions related to project management, including viewing Gantt charts, generating charts, updating tasks, deleting tasks, retrieving end dates, updating task order, fetching predecessors, creating and updating tasks, resource list management, resource chart updates, tooltips, and utility functions such as calculating days between dates. The file is part of a larger SugarCRM module for project management, specifically handling project-related operations through HTTP actions.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: Controller class for managing project-related actions in SugarCRM, including Gantt chart visualization, task CRUD operations, resource management, and utility functions for project timelines.

methods.name: action_view_GanttChart
methods.description: Loads the Gantt chart view for a project, verifying user access.

methods.name: action_generate_chart
methods.description: Generates a Gantt chart for a specified project, including retrieving task data, date calculations, and rendering HTML/JavaScript for the chart view.

methods.name: action_update_GanttChart
methods.description: Creates or updates a project task based on POST data, with logic for calculating start and end dates, handling business hours, and setting task properties.

methods.name: action_delete_task
methods.description: Marks a project task as deleted based on provided task ID, with access control.

methods.name: action_get_end_date
methods.description: Returns the end date of a task, adjusted for lag, used for AJAX dynamic updates.

methods.name: action_update_order
methods.description: Updates the order of tasks in a project based on a JSON array received via POST.

methods.name: action_get_predecessors
methods.description: Provides a list of predecessor tasks for a given project, outputting HTML <option> elements.

methods.name: create_task
methods.description: Helper function to instantiate and save a new project task with specified properties.

methods.name: update_task
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve and update an existing project task with new properties.

methods.name: action_ResourceList
methods.description: Loads the resource list view for project resource management.

methods.name: action_update_chart
methods.description: Updates the resource chart visualization based on selected users, contacts, projects, and date range.

methods.name: action_Tooltips
methods.description: Provides tooltip information for tasks assigned to a specific resource within a date range, in HTML table format.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Utility function counting days between two dates, returning -1 if end date precedes start date.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Utility function to validate whether a string is null or empty.
